basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/WhoisFreaks/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [WhoisFreaks](https://whoisfreaks.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests commercial threat intelligence and newly registered domain (NRD) feeds through the Codeless Connector Framework into custom Log Analytics tables for hunting, detection, and investigation. **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:** This solution depends on technologies that may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) or incur additional ingestion or operational costs: a. [Azure Monitor data collection rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/data-collection/data-collection-rule-overview) b. [Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/) A WhoisFreaks API subscription and key entitled to the selected feeds are required. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 4 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for WhoisFreaks Threat & NRD Feeds (via Codeless Connector Framework). You can get WhoisFreaks Threat & NRD Feeds (via Codeless Connector Framework) data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

options.text: This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.

elements.name: analytic1
elements.label: WhoisFreaks - burst of newly registered domains

options.text: Identifies unusually large NRD ingest volume that may indicate bulk registration campaigns.
Identifies high-confidence malware, phishing, and spam domains from WhoisFreaks threat feeds.

elements.name: analytic3
elements.label: WhoisFreaks - newly registered domain seen in threat feed

options.text: Identifies newly registered domains that are later observed in WhoisFreaks threat feeds.
Identifies threat-listed domains that are currently parked and may be used for staging.
